article.body: BAE Systems delivers two AMPV 30 prototypes to the Army, built with internal funding, in a project the service didn't formally request. The Army awarded XM30 detailed-design and prototype contracts to General Dynamics Land Systems and American Rheinmetall Vehicles in June 2023, leaving BAE Systems out of the competition. The cost of building the AMPV 30 prototypes is reported to be $17 million.
